<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Jawa corpse.

'''Card text:''' Use when two or more stormtroopers are at a location where the opponent has Jawas. Declare which Jawas and how many to target, then draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the number targeted, all targets are lost.

'''Lore:''' During the search for R2-D2, many Jawas were killed by stormtroopers. Banthas and gaffi sticks were used to make it look like the work of Tusken Raiders, but Obi-Wan was not deceived.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to declare which Jawas and how many to target; the English says to target as many Jawas there as desired. The English explicitly says the targeted Jawas are immediately lost; the Japanese does not specify immediately.
